svg.title: Notional Spacecraft – Multi-View Engineering Blueprint (SVG)
svg.desc: Professional-style aerospace engineering blueprint: Top, Side, Front, Rear, and Section A–A cutaway views of one spacecraft. Includes engines, propellant tanks, crew module, cockpit, airlocks, docking port, radiators, solar arrays, antennas, landing gear, cargo bay, avionics, and life-support. Contains dimensions, callouts, section lines, and scale markers. All geometry is notional for illustration.

g.text: NOTIONAL CREW/CARGO SPACECRAFT – ORTHOGRAPHIC ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT
All geometry is concept-only. Units: metres (m). Drawing style: external OML (bold), internal systems (thin), hidden edges (dashed).
05 Main engines (4) + center sustain engine (1) – clustered
13 Life-support (ECLSS) rack: CO₂ scrubbing, O₂, humidity control
14 Cargo bay with palletized payload interface
Views: Top / Side / Front / Rear / Section A–A. Line weights: OML 4px, primary 2px, secondary 1.5px.
Datum: Nose tip X=0. Engine plane X=54 m. Major units in metres. Do not use for fabrication.
• Hidden edges shown dashed. Section fill indicates cut material only (illustrative).
• Solar/radiator deployment angles simplified; hinges and latches not fully detailed.
• Propellant tank types shown as LOX/CH₄ for concept; plumbing and insulation are schematic.
